label: McLean County reviewed trails (candidate data, not approved)
attribution: Trail data: McLean County GIS Consortium (McGIS) and members, licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Reviewed existing trails only; filtered and normalized by Constitution Trail Mapper. Routes are generated and are not an official county map.

omitted.supplements: OpenStreetMap-derived trail supplements are not included: whether a merged routing graph is a derivative database under the ODbL is unresolved (docs/web/data-rights.md).
omitted.accessRoads: Street access data is not included, so routes only connect where the reviewed trails themselves connect; unverified street connections are never invented.

blockers: The redistribution basis for the six proposed branch geometries (OBJECTIDs 1929, 1952, 2349, 3824, 4275, 4772) is unresolved; they are omitted.
The ODbL classification of a merged OpenStreetMap graph is unresolved; supplements and street access data are omitted.
The owner has not approved this source composition for public release.
Physical iPhone Safari and Android Chrome acceptance (#41) has not been done.
Hosting and basemap decisions are open (docs/web/hosting-runbook.md); sign-in and sync are deferred by decision, as the first launch is guest-first.
